attempts.summary: Created a logical volume (vg_data/lv_data) on node1, backed by a loopback device since the only disk (20GB vda) is fully partitioned with no free space and XFS root can't be shrunk. Mounted it at /srv/data, grew it from ~1.17GB to ~2.54GB online while mounted, and verified file checksums stayed intact throughout. Wired persistence via a systemd oneshot service (losetup + vgchange -ay) ordered before the fstab-generated mount unit. Performed the mandatory single-node reboot and confirmed boot identity changed and the LV/mount/data all recovered automatically afterward.
